SVR ANTHOLOGY by Yumboy11 - on the WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 PC recomp
==========================================================================

SVR Anthology is made by Yumboy11. All credit for it goes to Yumboy11 and the
people he thanks in his own Readme.txt (in his installer's folder):
Brienj, Red Rooster, ryokudou, littlebase631, theviper12, xtremebrett,
tekken57, ERI619, eatrawmeat391, jakeypearce, Mark/Rampage, Justyn,
Sean O Connor, Wrestling Modders INC, RipZz, Obs Kenobs, WatchTheSmoke and
everyone who sent textures, suggestions and feedback.

SVR Anthology is freeware: never buy or sell it.

This download contains NOTHING of SVR Anthology. It is the SvR 2011 PC recomp's
game program and a small launcher that runs the Anthology you install yourself:

  - your own, unmodified WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 Xbox 360 ISO (or its
    extracted game folder), and
  - Yumboy11's own "SVR Anthology 1.0 Installer", downloaded from him.

Yumboy11 allows his Anthology to be used with this recomp on exactly those
terms: your own ISO, his own installer, and full credit to him.


HOW TO SET IT UP
----------------
1. Extract this zip into a plain folder of its own, for example
   C:\Games\SvR Anthology PC  (not inside the installer's folder or the
   Anthology's folder, and not in Documents, Desktop or OneDrive).
2. Start "SvR Anthology Launcher.exe".
3. Step 1: choose your SvR 2011 ISO (or extracted folder).
   Step 2: choose Yumboy11's "SVR Anthology 1.0 Installer" folder.
   Step 3: "Run Yumboy11's installer". His installer opens in its own window;
   answer it there. It makes two new folders NEXT TO ITSELF, in the
   installer's folder:
       WWE SmackDown vs Raw Anthology
       WWE SmackDown vs Raw Anthology Saves and DLC
   It needs a lot of free space on that drive (about 5 times the size of
   SvR 2011; it tells you how much). To have the Anthology on another drive,
   move the whole installer folder there BEFORE you run it - the launcher
   never moves or changes anything there.
   (Installed it already? Choose the "WWE SmackDown vs Raw Anthology" folder
   with Browse.)
4. Saves and DLC: follow Yumboy11's readme in his "Saves and DLC" folder.
5. PLAY.

This version has no mods, no Mod Maker and no online play: it runs the
Anthology as Yumboy11 made it. The game's settings, saves and DLC are kept in
this folder (svr2011.toml, Saves, DLC, UserData); the Anthology's folder is
only read, never written.

WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 belongs to its owners. SVR Anthology belongs to
Yumboy11.
